item_short_desc: Be apart of the flight crew with our Rothco Flight Crew Morale Patch!
description: Be apart of the flight crew with our Rothco Flight Crew Morale Patch! This black and gold morale patch is the perfect addition to any operator cap, tactical pack, or jacket! Stitched with rayon thread, the flight crew patch features a hook and loop backing, that can be worn with any of our hook and loop supported products.
